segments.title: Pre-Show Technical Setup & Kendall Pogo Attempt

segments.title: Australian Bluey Coin Heist

segments.title: Sign-Off & JD Vance Penis Expert Bit

episode_summary: Barely Informed News covered the Australian Bluey coin heist before pivoting to an Amongst the Web session with Leon Kennedy reviewing viral police and Olympic clips. The broadcast concluded with a whispered ASMR reading of the Small Penis Bible, a quiet Trip on the Street segment featuring Crum's grievance over a disputed debate vote, and a surprise JD Vance appearance dispensing anatomical misinformation before raiding Bruce Green.
